reason: Original decoupling arms intentionally kept mixed object names unknown; add explicit inference-stage multiview naming instead of evaluator-derived names.
inputs: Read sealed family_v3 depth-checked projected masks plus frozen experimental instance arrays; no GT, RGB model, CLIP, SAM, SGA or LLM calls.
rules: Each original map point contributes once per distinct original frame.
Frame observation is eligible only if it has interior=true, nonzero projected semantic and finite confidence>=0.8.
For an object, require>=30 qualifying points in a frame and sum(confidence for dominant class)/sum(confidence for all qualifying classes)>=0.8. Otherwise frame abstains.
Each eligible frame casts exactly one unweighted vote for its dominant class.
Require>=3 eligible distinct frames and winner votes/all eligible votes>=0.8; otherwise semantic_id=0.
IDs33/34 remain coarse and cannot be remapped to a fine class.
Name is dictionary lookup for accepted class only; no invented business-specific names.
Report visibility, point support and class vote counts; naming confidence fraction is a heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
output: Per base-arm scene add objects_named.json and naming_result.json; do not overwrite objects.json, map_labels.npz, result.json or point/map files.
